_doc: The Passenger (2026-11-03, s09 fitter). Same body + hat as the Tycoon: src/hats/tophat.js with its gold band + gold brim trim (his f816-852 show both, so bandOn/trimOn stay 1), no hair visible (tracks/passenger/head.json: a tiny hair patch hidden under the crown). Torso: outfit 'passenger' in src/torso.js (Tycoon pill, purple suit, lined fabric, inked V lapels, shirt sliver + dotted tie, 2 dark buttons, 2 welt pockets). Limbs .056 / hands .058 as the Tycoon. Prop: src/props/teacup.js (cup + saucer + the far hand's oval thumb). Tracks: tracks/passenger/*.json + per shot *.s09.json (tools/s09_build.py).
